shots.line: Under the northern lights, you tracked down three recently funded startups across Helsinki.
At Töölönlahdenkatu 2, Verda raised USD 189 million in Series B funding to run its AI cloud and data centres.
At Henry Fordin katu 6, ReOrbit secured a 45 million euro Series A round to build sovereign satellites and software.
On Kalevankatu 30, Aibidia raised 25 million euros in Series B funding to automate cross-border tax compliance.
Three companies, newly backed, building from their addresses in the night.
